RESUMES OF PETER BLAZUNAS, LANCE SCHAFER, AND HANHAN HAMMER 
 
 
PG. 1 
PETER BLAZUNAS 
VICE PRESIDENT 
PROFESSIONAL HISTORY 
Concentric Energy Advisors, Inc.  
Vice President (January 2026 – Present) 
Assistant Vice President (January 2024 – December 2025) 
Senior Project Manager (January 2023 - December 2023) 
Project Manager (October 2021 - December 2022)  
 
Currently serve as the project manager and expert witness for a long-term staff augmentation 
engagement with Narragansett Electric Company (“NECO”, also known as Rhode Island 
Energy) following its acquisition by PPL from National Grid. Staff augmentation services 
include the provision of expert witness testimony and analyst support in the litigation of gas 
and electric rate mechanism proceedings, the execution of both internal and external monthly 
reporting, the development of written processes and procedures, and the training of new 
personnel.  
 
Executes projects and initiatives related to cost of service and rate design and, where 
appropriate, serves as an expert witness in regulatory proceedings. 
 
A recent engagement included the provision of expert witness testimony with respect to rate 
design in a multi-year rate plan application for an electric utility in Maryland.  
 
Manages all phases of assigned projects with teams of senior staff and supporting analysts 
across multiple offices. 
Mr. Blazunas primarily provides regulatory strategy and rate case expertise as it pertains to 
regulated electric and gas utility rate proceedings. Mr. Blazunas joined Concentric in October 
2021 after spending nine years in positions of progressively greater responsibility in the regulatory 
departments of large investor-owned electric utilities. Prior to joining Concentric, Mr. Blazunas 
managed a team at Exelon Corp. responsible for the cost of service, revenue allocation, rate 
design, revenue decoupling, and rate administration functions for Exelon’s Pepco Maryland 
and District of Columbia jurisdictions. Mr. Blazunas has experience testifying in both traditional 
base distribution rate case and multiyear rate plan proceedings, as well as in developing, 
supporting, and implementing utility of the future initiatives, including transportation 
electrification programs. Mr. Blazunas has testified as an expert witness before the Rhode Island 
Public Utilities Commission, the Public Utilities Commission of Ohio, the Maryland Public Service 
Commission, the Public Service Commission of the District of Columbia, and the Delaware 
Public Service Commission. Mr. Blazunas holds a B.A. in Economics from the University of Dayton 
and an M.A. in Economics from the University of Akron. He has taught both graduate and 
undergraduate Economics at the University of Akron and undergraduate Economics at 
Cuyahoga Community College.

Manager of Rate Administration (November 2018 – January 2021) 
Senior Rate Analyst (July 2017 – November 2018) 
 
Managed a team of four rate analysts responsible for the cost of service and rate design 
functions with respect to Pepco’s base distribution rates.  
 
Served as the rate design witness for Pepco’s Maryland and District of Columbia base 
distribution rate case and multi-year rate plan proceedings, with a focus on revenue allocation, 
rate design, and decoupling in both traditional and non-traditional contexts.  
 
Served as the rate design and cost recovery witness for several of Exelon’s Pepco Holdings Inc. 
(“PHI") jurisdictions with respect to transportation electrification.  
 
Oversaw the development of self-contained cost-of-service (“COS”) and rate design Microsoft 
Excel models for use in regulatory proceedings.  
 
Guided the creation of concise and well-written processes and procedures as it relates to the 
development of base distribution rates, numerous distribution riders, and transmission retail 
rates.  
 
Directed the development of internal project plan templates for use in executing initiatives 
related to the implementation of traditional and innovative rates.  
 
Supervised the development of internal documents to direct Pepco’s policy positions on a range 
of issues in work group settings with a diverse set of external stakeholders (primarily, the 
Maryland Public Service Commission Public Conference 44 Rate Design Working Group and the 
District of Columbia Public Service Commission Rate Design Working Group). 
First Energy Corp., Akron, OH  
State Regulatory Analyst (January 2012 – June 2017) 
 
Served as the lead analyst for the FirstEnergy Ohio operating companies’ Delivery Capital 
Recovery Rider (“Rider DCR”). Duties included the preparation of a detailed quarterly filing 
with the Public Utilities Commission of Ohio (“PUCO”) that requires complex revenue 
requirement calculations, extensive intra-company communication and collaboration in the 
development of financial inputs, month-to-month analysis, and participation in an annual audit 
conducted by an outside consultant on behalf of the PUCO.  
 
Duties also included (a) the role of Rates and Regulatory Affairs Department point of contact 
for internal customers in relation to the application of The Cleveland Electric Illuminating 
Company’s and The Toledo Edison Company’s tariffs and (b) participation in various state 
regulatory proceedings, including testifying in front of the PUCO.

Lance Schafer joined Concentric in September 2024 after ten years of experience in the utility 
regulation field with increasing responsibilities. Most recently, Mr. Schafer managed a team at 
Pepco Holdings, Inc., responsible for class cost of service, rate design, and rate administration 
functions for the Pepco DC, Pepco MD, and Delmarva Power MD jurisdictions. Mr. Schafer has 
provided testimony in traditional base distribution rate cases, multi-year rate plans, and 
streetlighting proceedings on the subjects of cost of capital, class cost of service, and rate 
design before several Public Service Commissions. He holds a Master of Business Administration 
from the University of Missouri, Columbia.

HANHAN HAMMER 
SENIOR PROJECT MANAGER 
EXPERTISE & KEY SKILLS 
 
Energy Industry Expertise – 15+ years of experience in ISO/RTO markets and stakeholder 
process, utility regulation, transmission ratemaking, wholesale and retail tariff design, 
market revenue forecasting, resource and transmission planning, and regulatory compliance. 
 
Regulatory Strategy & Testimony – Extensive experience preparing tariff filings, provided 
expert witness testimony, and advising clients through FERC and state regulatory 
proceedings. 
 
Wholesale Markets – Led design of market rules for DERs, energy storage, and ancillary 
services; skilled in market power analysis, revenue forecasting, and locational marginal price 
formation. 
 
Strategic Communication – Effective at translating complex regulatory and technical issues 
into clear insights for executives, regulators, policymakers, and industry forums. 
 
Project & Team Leadership – Strong record of managing cross-functional teams, guiding 
complex initiatives under fixed budgets, and delivering results. Directed cross-functional 
project teams, ensuring projects were completed on scope, budget, and schedule; presented 
findings to executives and regulators to support high-stakes decision-making. 
PROFESSIONAL HISTORY 
Concentric Energy Advisors (2024 – Present) 
Senior Project Manager 
 
Shaped client regulatory strategy by supporting filings and expert testimony on large load 
tariffs, transmission ratemaking, ancillary service rates in merger cases, and market power 
analyses, directly informing multimillion-dollar business decisions. 
 
Advised utilities and developers on compliance and opportunity capture under evolving 
federal and state rules (e.g., Order 2222, transmission–distribution coordination, data center 
interconnection/colocation), enabling clients to position early for regulatory and market 
advantages. 
Ms. Hammer is a recognized expert in the energy industry with more than 15 years of experience 
in utility regulation and ISO/RTO markets. At Concentric, she advises utilities, developers, grid 
operators, and regulators on complex regulatory and market issues, including large load tariffs, 
transmission ratemaking, resource and transmission planning, FERC Order compliance, and 
wholesale market strategies. Her work has helped clients secure critical regulatory approvals, 
optimize capital investments, and unlock new revenue streams.
